design: agent-session replay, persistent server per phase, ~100.5k-token real project context, 8 turns (tool results/web dumps), 512-token greedy replies, stock upstream v1.3.4

decision_rules.a_cache_misses_dominate: REFUTED — turns 2-8 all fast (36-79 s) with prompt growing to 110.8k; prefix cache holds through the session
decision_rules.b_prefill_dominates: turn1 only (cold prefill ~95% of turn time, ~93 tok/s effective); warm turns are decode+overhead mixed
decision_rules.c_decode_bound_disk: not fired — no thrash signature in warm turns
decision_rules.d_mtp_wins: REFUTED — MTP(1) is +5.4% SLOWER mean on warm turns (wins 2/14); rule needed MTP >=8% BETTER on both reps

verdict: stock mainline + no-draft is the practical serving config at 100k+ on this box; speculative decoding stays off in serving
